blocked_on: Complete extra12 and matched-control results with immutable pins before comparative scoring.

checks.command: Inspect evaluator accuracy/validity rules and frozen sparse/richer selection policies; run six label-free synthetic ranking and slot-allocation checks
checks.result: No conflicting numerical formula found. Correct/28, valid/28, known cost plus retained uncertain reservations, then config ID. Ten unique eligible configurations under family-plus-global rule; 96 cells retained.

limitations: Promotion allocates more extraction replicates; it is not a fidelity winner, confirmed best method or FINALISTS_FROZEN claim.
Original sparse grid remains promotion scope; richer source-only study is separate and not pooled as extra replicates.
Conditional valid accuracy, joint-valid paired differences, Brier and order consistency are reported separately and do not alter the ranking key.
Source groups remain two Neel and one Chris; repeated orderings, replicates and aliases do not add source independence.
